summary: The legal array contains at most 50 entries, which is too narrow for honest timing-based class separation; exhaustive and boundary evidence verifies the accepted one-pass scan.

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted loop reads each of the n entries exactly once, performs one threshold comparison, and updates only one scalar counter.
Regression exhausts small arrays and thresholds and checks minimum and maximum lengths, zero and maximum values, equality, all, none, and mixed qualification.
